meta.notes: segments = sorted, clipped, merged violent (or other-anomaly) segments in seconds; empty for clean negatives, unlabelled and hold-out videos. other_segments = non-violent anomaly segments of mixed-label XD clips (excluded time). mask_spans = violence / aftermath of another clip of the same XD source film, or (clean clips) its 120 s pre-onset window: excluded, and it ends a clear lead-in. soft_mask_spans = the pre-onset window of such violence inside a violent clip, outside the clip's own pre-onset windows: excluded, does not end a lead-in. events = per-segment eligibility (labels.event_table) for violent videos. hivau_segments are given for cross-reference where official onsets were used. pseudo_onsets_sec are LSTM pseudo-labels (not ground truth). duplicate_of = canonical copy of an identical re-encode.

rules.identical: durations within max(1 s, 1 %); >= 5 informative fraction-aligned frames, median corr >= 0.97, median MAD <= 3
rules.overlap: LSH head-frame candidates; >= max(6, 60 % of overlap) frames with corr >= 0.95 and MAD <= 6 at the best integer-second lag

hivau.note: only entries with a non-empty label; events_sec in seconds as given by HIVAU
